title: Decide GLM 5.3 thinking-level map: pi-ai clamps medium to high
description:
pi-ai 1.0.2's catalog maps GLM 5.3 medium/minimal/off/xhigh to null (unsupported), so a dispatch asking for medium effort sends reasoning_effort high, and off sends no thinking field. Workers AI accepted low/medium/high/max/none on staging. If tiers are meant to differ by effort, add a thinkingLevelMap override to GATEWAY_MODEL_OVERRIDES (medium: 'medium', off: 'none'), after an A/B on real ticks shows that effort actually changes GLM's behaviour.
evidence: harness/test/gateway-provider.test.ts 'sends GLM 5.3 the effort pi-ai's catalog maps each thinking level to'
